items.title: Triple-Digit Heat Sends Southwest Natural Gas Prices Skyrocketing
items.summary: Desert Southwest and Southern California natural gas prices soared on Friday as temperatures in Phoenix approached 115 degrees.

items.title: Freeport LNG Trip Adds Volatility to Recovering US Feedgas Demand
items.summary: A Thursday afternoon operational trip at Freeport LNG added another burst of volatility to US feedgas nominations, but gains at other export terminals kept national demand on an upward path as feedgas deliveries continue to rise.

items.title: Winter Strip Outshines Listless August Futures as Natural Gas Market Looks Past Injection Season
items.summary: Prompt month natural gas futures scratched and clawed their way to their first weekly gain since June 18, in contrast to double-digit gains for the November-March slate of contracts.

items.title: Natural Gas Futures Stall Near $3 as Weather, Storage Temper Buying
items.summary: August natural gas futures continued to trade sideways Friday, dipping before rebounding toward the $3.00/MMBtu mark as traders balanced short-term demand fluctuations against robust production and ample supplies.

items.title: Escalating Iran War Seen Curbing Even More LNG Supply Through Year’s End
items.summary: QatarEnergy has extended force majeure on LNG shipments to Asian customers through mid-October.

items.title: Summer Heat Ignites Forward Natural Gas Prices
items.summary: Resilient summer heat is finally lifting the forward curve, with trading volume ticking higher in some parts of the country amid record power burn and forecasts calling for more hot weather.
